items.headline: Puckett throws 2 TD passes and Mississippi State beats Tennessee Tech, ends 6-game losing streak
items.description: — Billy Puckett threw a pair of touchdown passes and Mississippi State’s offense looked as good as it has in months in the Bulldogs’ 34-16 win over Tennessee Tech on Saturday that snapped a six-game losing streak.
